rationale: The Latin anchors are decisive here: *bulga* (leather bag/sack), *follis* (bellows/bag), *uter* (wineskin/leather flask), and *siliqua* (pod/husk) all point to a hollow, bag-like container rather than the anatomical abdomen. OE *belg* primarily denotes a bag, pouch, or skin — something with a hollow interior — which aligns best with belly.n.04 ("the hollow inside of something"), the sense that captures the container/vessel notion shared by all four Latin glosses.
